input: one inspection or fault event with an id, vehicle, fault code, severity, timestamp, and optional note
workflow: crash after prepare or after effects, then resume or rollback
acceptance: a duplicate event plus crash/resume produces one work order, one escalation, and one receipt
crash after prepare leaves no external effect
crash after effects persists deterministic effect ids; resume detects them and commits without duplication
rollback of an incomplete run leaves no committed effect
a reused id with different bytes is rejected
deliverables: fit verdict for one approved workflow

commercial.refund: If the accepted diagnostic is not delivered inside the one-business-day window, the paid diagnostic amount is refunded unless the buyer elects in writing to receive one free next-business-day repair instead.

data_boundary: synthetic inputs only; no vehicle credentials; no production fleet connection
decision_boundary: work-order routing only; never dispatches a technician
